verdicts.reason: A keeps the plans in the original order (Monthly, Yearly, Family) and the price cards are readable, with a clear left-to-right flow ending at the CTA. But the cards nearly touch the top and bottom edges, the headline is too small to lead over the cards, the logo is pushed into a cramped left margin, and the legal text is tiny. B makes the price cards so small that their labels and per-month copy can't be read, swaps the order to 6/80/48 so Yearly comes last, and jams the cards against the CTA. Its subtitle and legal text are crammed into the right edge, with the legal text running to the bottom, and the oversized headline dwarfs the actual offer.
